framework.name: executable predicate table for proof-carrying observable identity
framework.cross_domain_jump: proof-carrying execution + runtime admission control + typed provenance contracts
framework.core_translation: An O_s claim enters a finite executor as a record. The executor evaluates mode-specific predicates over required fields. A mode PASS is returned only when every required field exists and every check for that mode succeeds.
framework.observable_identity: O_s := (reported_scalar_value, source_bibliographic_id, stable_source_locator, canonical_structure_id, structure_hash, same_structure_mapping, pair_cutoff_policy, pair_enumerator_hash_or_pair_list, N_pair, raw_overlap_sum, normalization_formula_or_code_hash, declared_constants, tolerance_rule, executor_trace, input_digest, intermediate_digest, output_digest, verifier_version, terminal_status)

changes_from_round1.change: Converted the finite-state calculus from mode descriptions into an executable predicate table with predicate_id, required_fields, pass_condition, warn_condition, block_condition, and terminal_status.
Repaired the reported_context ambiguity: context PASS now requires a stable source locator; without that locator the terminal status is BLOCK or unresolved scalar, never unconditional PASS.
Added a transition guard predicate so no claim can silently upgrade modes by numeric closeness, executor quality, narrative plausibility, or generic provenance hygiene.

Answered Q6.4 explicitly: the framework is not merely generic provenance hygiene, but it does carry a residual risk of being over-broad unless tied to observable-specific proof fields and terminal predicates.

primitive_checks.locator_check: stable_source_locator resolves to a durable source object at page/table/row/figure/repository granularity and supports only the claimed source-reported context.
primitive_checks.identity_check: canonical_structure_id and structure_hash identify the structure under declared canonicalization.
primitive_checks.mapping_check: same_structure_mapping binds source structure and reproduced structure as the same object under the declared canonicalization.
primitive_checks.pair_check: pair_cutoff_policy and pair_enumerator_hash_or_pair_list deterministically define the admitted pair set.
primitive_checks.cardinality_check: N_pair equals the enumerated pair-set cardinality.
primitive_checks.sum_check: raw_overlap_sum is recomputed over exactly the admitted pair set.
primitive_checks.normalization_check: reported_scalar_value follows from raw_overlap_sum through normalization_formula_or_code_hash with declared_constants and tolerance_rule.
primitive_checks.trace_check: executor_trace binds software, parameters, environment, input_digest, intermediate_digest, output_digest, and reproduced value.
primitive_checks.verifier_version_check: the predicate executor version is recorded so later audits know which checks were applied.

predicate_calculus.transition_rule: A transition from mode i to mode j is legal only when all required_fields for target mode j are present and all target primitive checks pass. Numeric closeness, code quality, bibliographic familiarity, or better narrative provenance is not a transition witness.
predicate_calculus.reported_context_rule: reported_context PASS is conditional on source_bibliographic_id plus stable_source_locator. If the locator is absent, the executor returns BLOCK for context PASS and may retain only an unresolved scalar note.

current_terminal_status.current_claim_under_PI_summary: BLOCK for exact O_s; reported context remains conditional because the stable locator has not been supplied in the consumed inputs.

q64_alternative_explanation.question: Is this just generic provenance hygiene?
q64_alternative_explanation.answer: No as a Round 2 result: the executable table is narrower than generic provenance hygiene because it binds exact O_s to observable-specific proof predicates. Yes only as a failure mode: if future work strips away those predicates and keeps only source attribution language, the claim degenerates into generic provenance hygiene.
why_not_generic: Generic provenance hygiene says record where data came from. This calculus gates exact O_s on field-specific physics/computation witnesses: structure hash, same-structure mapping, pair cutoff policy, pair enumerator or pair list, N_pair, raw overlap sum, normalization executable or formula, constants, tolerance, and executor trace.
The table creates mode-separating terminal statuses. A stable locator can pass only reported_context; it cannot pass pair policy, raw sum, normalization, trace, or exact certification.
The transition guard blocks the usual provenance-hygiene failure mode: a better narrative or cleaner citation cannot upgrade a scalar into exact observable identity.
domain_specific_obligations: O_s certification must identify the structure, not just the paper: canonical_structure_id, structure_hash, and same_structure_mapping are mandatory for exact mode.
O_s certification must identify the pair population: pair_cutoff_policy, pair_enumerator_hash_or_pair_list, and N_pair are mandatory because the scalar depends on which pairs were summed.

O_s certification must bind computation: raw_overlap_sum, normalization_formula_or_code_hash, declared_constants, tolerance_rule, executor_trace, and digests are mandatory because the final scalar is a derived observable, not a freestanding datum.
Context citation and exact reproduction are different propositions. A stable locator can prove only reported_context unless the remaining exact-mode predicates also pass.
risk_admitted: If future users collapse the table into a generic checklist, the claim becomes ordinary reproducibility hygiene and loses the B-route novelty.
If stable locator requirements are weakened, reported_context can again be misread as unconditional PASS.
If pair enumeration and normalization are not executable, exact O_s remains blocked even when bibliographic provenance is excellent.
q64_alternative_explanation.risk_control: Keep the executor predicates as the authority. The claim is only the narrow contract: exact O_s certification requires all exact-mode proof objects and checks; anything less is a lower terminal mode.

claims.statement: The Round 1 finite-state proof-carrying observable calculus can be made executable as a predicate table with mode-specific required fields, PASS/WARN/BLOCK conditions, and terminal statuses.
equations: pass(mode, record) := required_fields(mode) subset fields(record) and all_checks(mode, record) = true
terminal_status(mode, record) in {PASS, WARN, BLOCK, REJECT}
references: B Round 1 source records: proof-carrying code, proof-carrying hardware, PROV, workflow provenance
assumptions: The observable can be represented as a finite record.
The verifier can evaluate deterministic field-presence and equality/hash/cardinality/normalization checks.

claims.statement: reported_context is not an unconditional PASS mode; it passes only when a stable source locator exists and only for context-level reporting.
assumptions: Stable locator means durable page/table/row/figure/repository granularity rather than generic bibliographic identity.

claims.statement: The framework is narrower than generic provenance hygiene because exact O_s certification requires executable pair-population, raw-sum, normalization, mapping, and trace checks, not merely source attribution.
equations: required(exact_certified_observable) strictly contains generic_provenance plus observable-specific computational witnesses
assumptions: Future PI/inspector work preserves predicate-level terminal statuses.

deepening_1.question: Does the executable predicate table expose a deeper mathematical structure than the Round 1 finite-state labels?

layer_1.structure: partial function from records to terminal statuses
layer_1.mapping: Each mode is a partial evaluator over a record schema. Undefined or missing required fields do not default to PASS; they map to BLOCK or WARN according to the predicate.
layer_1.consequence: The reported_context bug is a type error: a missing locator cannot inhabit the PASS branch.

layer_2.structure: monotone proof lattice with non-monotone terminal claims
layer_2.mapping: Adding fields can move a record upward in auditability, but terminal claims are not monotone in scalar agreement. Exact PASS requires all target predicates, while a failed check can demote or block despite more data.
layer_2.consequence: The calculus prevents silent upgrades: a richer narrative is not equivalent to a proof object.

deepening_2.question: Does proof-carrying execution have a next-layer extension that maps back to O_s?

layer_1.source_extension: runtime admission control separates loadable artifacts from executable artifacts by checking certificates before execution.
layer_1.mapping: O_s claims should be separated into archived scalar, context report, bounded attempt, trace-bound attempt, and exact-certified observable before any scientific conclusion consumes them.
layer_1.consequence: The executor table is not documentation; it is an admission barrier.

layer_2.source_extension: typed proof systems distinguish evidence for proposition A from evidence for proposition B even when the same document is cited.
layer_2.mapping: A stable source locator proves only 'the source reported this context'; it does not prove 'the exact observable identity was reproduced'. Pair/sum/normalization/trace predicates prove different propositions.
layer_2.consequence: The repaired reported_context condition is logically necessary, not cosmetic wording.

forbidden_claims: A generic bibliography entry is enough for context PASS.
A stable locator for context upgrades a claim to exact O_s.
Executor quality alone certifies observable identity.
Generic provenance hygiene is sufficient for exact O_s certification.
Exact O_s is impossible in principle.
A graph descriptor can replace overlap provenance for exact O_s.
Graph-vs-overlap residual regression is relevant to this round's claim.
